acceptance/test_intervals_overlap.py.final:
import pytest

from slotplan.intervals_overlap import intervals_overlap


def test_overlap_cases():
    assert intervals_overlap((540, 600), (570, 630)) is True
    assert intervals_overlap((540, 720), (600, 630)) is True
    assert intervals_overlap((600, 660), (540, 600)) is False


def test_empty_intervals():
    assert intervals_overlap((600, 600), (540, 660)) is False


def test_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        intervals_overlap((600, 540), (500, 700))

acceptance/test_parse_shift.py.initial:
import pytest

from slotplan.parse_shift import parse_shift


def test_basic_entries():
    assert parse_shift("Tue 09:00-17:00") == (1, 540, 1020)
    assert parse_shift("  Sat   07:30-12:00 ") == (5, 450, 720)
    assert parse_shift("Mon 22:00-06:00") == (0, 1320, 1800)


def test_day_spellings():
    assert parse_shift("friday 08:00-16:00") == (4, 480, 960)
    assert parse_shift("SUN 10:00-14:00") == (6, 600, 840)


def test_rejects_bad_entries():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_shift("Tues 09:00-17:00")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_shift("Mon")


def test_regression_issue_390():
    assert parse_shift("SUN 10:00-14:00") == (0, 600, 840)

acceptance/test_uncovered_periods.py.initial:
import pytest

from slotplan.uncovered_periods import uncovered_periods


def test_same_day_gaps():
    assert uncovered_periods({"kim": ["Mon 08:00-12:00"], "ann": ["Mon 13:00-18:00"]}, 0, 480, 1080) == [(720, 780)]
    assert uncovered_periods({"kim": ["Mon 08:00-12:00"]}, 2, 480, 1080) == [(480, 1080)]
    assert uncovered_periods({"kim": ["Fri 07:00-15:00"], "bo": ["Fri 14:00-22:00"]}, 4, 480, 1200) == []


def test_overnight_cover():
    assert uncovered_periods({"kim": ["Tue 06:00-14:00"], "lee": ["Mon 22:00-06:30"]}, 1, 0, 1440) == [(840, 1440)]
    assert uncovered_periods({"max": ["Sun 20:00-04:00"], "ann": ["Mon 08:00-16:00"]}, 0, 0, 960) == [(240, 480)]


def test_invalid_day():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        uncovered_periods({}, 7, 480, 1080)


def test_regression_issue_741():
    assert uncovered_periods({"kim": ["Tue 06:00-14:00"], "lee": ["Mon 22:00-06:30"]}, 1, 0, 1440) == [(0, 360), (840, 1440)]
